correctness.rationale: At infinity v(x)=-5,v(y)=-8,v(dx)=26 give precisely 14 regular x^i y^j dx; an exact all-columns Cartier identity yields four invariant pivots and only residual 2x2 matrix [[2B,2A+B²],[-2A,0]]. Its determinant gives the rank 4/5/6 strata and the unique rank4 origin for all geometric coefficients. The tame involution invariant six-dimensional subspace has Cartier rank2 and genus6, so Prym a-number follows from degree2 prime-to-5 isogeny. Two separate standard-library scripts pass symbolic and complete F5/F25 tests; no inference from finite enumeration to the algebraic closure.

value.rationale: The minimum a-number eight for pole order eight was motivated by the existing existence literature, but this result determines all higher-a parameters as two tangent divisors meeting at a unique deepest degeneration, plus a constant quotient and varying Prym factor. These are natural and potentially reusable geometric a-number-jump data for a full coefficient-marked two-parameter family, not isolated trivial substitutions or a bounded field census.
